::: {#def-nffrcistg .theorem}
##  NFFRCISTG model

A network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (NFFRCISTG) is a causal model of an NPSEM-IE $\mathcal M$ under intervention regime $\Gamma$. By assumption, $\mathcal M$ satisfies: (1) [no spillover](#def-no-spillover), (2) [homogenous network interference](#def-no-interference) with respect to some graph set $\mathcal H$, and (3) [identical distributions](#def-identical-distributions). 


:::
